games.name: [Fixes] Naoya game!
games.desc:
Through Projection Sorcery, your character accelerates the longer you remain in motion. Starting at a base speed of 16, your goal is to push your velocity to its current limit..

The objective is to crash into walls to convert your accumulated speed into Die Money. Upon reaching your maximum speed, a countdown timer will activate. When the countdowns end you die.

Die Money can be spent on three upgrade categories: Speed, Acceleration, and Strength.

Speed: Increases your maximum velocity up to 300. 

Acceleration: Reduces the time required to reach your maximum speed.

Strength: Reaching level 5 grants a 20-second extension to the death timer.

Controls:
[E] - Unique Ability

Advanced movement and passives allow players to surpass the standard speed cap, reaching velocities of 500 or more.
